question_text: What is the SI unit of pressure?
explanation: Pressure is force per unit area. Its SI unit is N/m², named the pascal (Pa).
source: Original question; independently checked against NCERT Class 9 Science, Gravitation (pressure and SI unit), https://www.ncert.nic.in/textbook/pdf/iesc109.pdf

question_text: A block has a mass of 600 g and a volume of 200 cm³. What is its density?
explanation: Density = mass ÷ volume = 600 g ÷ 200 cm³ = 3 g/cm³.
source: Original question; independently checked calculation using density = mass/volume (NCERT Class 9 Science), https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php?jesc1=1-11

question_text: How does energy from the Sun travel through the vacuum of space to Earth?
explanation: Conduction and convection require matter. Electromagnetic radiation can travel through a vacuum, so solar energy reaches Earth by radiation.
source: Original question; independently checked against NCERT Class 9 Science concepts of radiation and solar energy, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php?jesc1=1-11

question_text: A force of 20 N acts uniformly over an area of 4 m². What pressure does it exert?
explanation: Pressure = force ÷ area = 20 N ÷ 4 m² = 5 N/m² = 5 Pa.
source: Original question; independently checked against NCERT Class 9 Science, Gravitation (pressure = thrust/area and SI unit), https://www.ncert.nic.in/textbook/pdf/iesc109.pdf

question_text: Which statement about the density of a uniform substance is correct?
option_a: It is mass multiplied by volume.
option_b: It is volume divided by mass.
option_c: It is mass per unit volume.
option_d: It is independent of both mass and volume.
explanation: Density is defined as mass per unit volume: density = mass ÷ volume.
source: Original question; independently checked against NCERT Class 9 Science definition of density, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php?jesc1=1-11
